g3-implement.title: Build the role-spine-template bookend lint
g3-implement.imperative: CREW-WAIVED reasoning gate (same latitude as g1/g2). Write a new script (e.g. scripts/check_role_spine_bookends.py) that: (a) globs skills/*/templates/*_SPINE.template.json in the repo and fails if any declares zero "bookend": true tasks; (b) for each such template, compares its set of bookend task ids against the installed corpus copy (constellation-<skill>/templates/<name> under the resolved skills root) and fails on drift (declared-but-not-installed or vice versa). check_skill_freshness.py's check() compares a PROJECT's .agent-work/templates/{.baseline,local} against installed upstream — it has no notion of repo-source-vs-installed and no manifest for this repo's own skill sources, so its three-way machinery does not fit; write a small standalone script instead and say so in the Return artifact. Do NOT modify checklist_engine.py::_is_bookend() or its permissive default. Write tests including a red-proof fixture (an undeclared template) and a green-proof fixture (a declared, undrifted template). Verify with the new test file before advancing.

postconditions.statement: new lint's own test suite passes, including a red-proof (fails on undeclared template) and a green-proof (passes on declared, undrifted template)
